ModMetaData.name: Nuna Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Mlie.StarWarsAnimalCollection's Nuna art (all 3 life stages share one bodyGraphicData texPath, swanimals/Nuna/Nuna, no gendered split) with custom generated art per the 2026-09-11 owner ruling on `art: "improve"` rows: Star Wars-named creatures keep their canon identity, full regeneration, heavy black outline required. The dessicated-corpse texture (Nuna_Dessicated) stays on donor art. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path the donor uses across all 3 life stages, so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
